outcome: Adequacy of information provided to patients
Awareness of reporting mechanisms for violence
cohort: 326 patients who underwent deliveries, cesarean sections, or abortions at the Labor Area of the General Hospital of the West 'Dr. Jose Gregorio Hernandez' in Caracas between June and October 2012.
finding: The prevalence of obstetric violence was 26.3%, with psychological violence being the most common type, and inadequate information provision and lack of informed consent being frequently reported.
